title: LangChain as an integration alternative
subtitle: Learn the abstractions while keeping business authority in existing services.
goal: Use model and tool interfaces without moving business authority
intro: LangChain can connect models, tools, middleware, and output schemas, but your application still owns its rules.
terms: One call into the configured model or agent
case: Wrap an existing support service as a LangChain tool.
The adapter remains small because identity and business validation stay in the service.
A convenient user_id argument can let the model select another user's authority.
